title: Sub-Scope Package Preparation Delivery
summary: add collection-local checkbox selection and extend Prepare Package to exact sub-scope documents as an explicitly export-only workflow
content_html:
Sub-Scope Package Preparation Delivery

Status And Order

Proposed as SSI-3, after Sub-Scope Detail Delete Delivery. Implementation has not started.

SSI-3 is the broadest delivery. It follows SSI-2 so the manage controller, capability projection, busy/error handling, collection refresh, public isolation, and realistic header/list layout have already been proved by a smaller exact-target workflow.

Complete Outcome

Manage mode gives a docs_subscope list the same compact selection language as the main Index:

  • an Actions control enters selection mode;
  • checkboxes appear as siblings to row navigation;
  • Select all, Clear, and Done control the current collection selection; and
  • the sub-scope Actions menu offers Prepare package… for one or more checked documents.

The package workflow reads exact sources from { scope, sub_scope }, validates checked IDs against that collection, and records the complete collection identity in package provenance.

Every package prepared from a sub-scope is export-only in this delivery. It is not actionable in Returned Packages, Docs Review, or Docs Import.

Change Classification

kind work
shipped and retained compact Index Actions/selection interaction; pure selection transitions; Prepare Package modal; package profiles and engine
refactored isolate collection-neutral selection transitions and package source-context mechanics while preserving current Index behavior
extended add a separate sub-scope selection owner and optional sub_scope package request/source/provenance support
genuinely new sub-scope checkboxes, list Actions/selection controls, and package preparation from checked child documents

The same interaction system is reused; the Index and sub-scope collection keep separate state owners and cannot supply targets to one another.

Selection Contract

The sub-scope selection owner is keyed by { scope, sub_scope }.

  • Only checked IDs are action targets.
  • Opening Actions enters selection mode but does not preselect the parent report or an unvalidated detail target.
  • Checkbox clicks do not navigate.
  • Shift-check extends from the collection's range anchor across currently visible eligible rows.
  • Row navigation remains available while selection is active.
  • Returning from detail to the same mounted collection may preserve selection.
  • Inventory refresh prunes missing IDs and retains eligible checked IDs.
  • Collection change, report unmount, leaving manage mode, or Done clears the owner according to the accepted lifecycle.
  • Select all selects the current eligible collection inventory.
  • Clear empties checked IDs.
  • Done exits and clears selection.
  • The compact command group does not add a selected-count label.

The sub-scope action menu contains only capabilities deliberately adopted by this feature. Copy, Move, bulk Delete, scope actions, and Review Package do not appear merely because the main Index menu supports them.

Package Contract

The existing Prepare Package workflow remains the modal and export owner. A sub-scope request adds one normalized collection field:

scope:     <parent scope>
sub_scope: <configured child>
doc_ids:   <effective checked IDs>

The browser and service must:

  • list and validate documents from the configured child source root;
  • treat the collection as flat and never infer parent-scope descendants;
  • derive effective IDs after supported visibility/summary options;
  • never add an ID excluded by the submitted checked selection;
  • resolve selection and source records by doc_id, never title;
  • render content through the existing package engine;
  • include scope, sub_scope, selected/exported IDs, profile, and generated time in internal provenance and result payloads;
  • project sub-scope runs as supports_return_import: false, even when the same profile supports return for a top-level scope;
  • omit or replace return/import instructions in external context for that export-only projection; and
  • exclude the resulting metadata/files from actionable returned-package listing and review.

Top-level scope package preparation remains unchanged when sub_scope is absent.

In Scope

  • One sub-scope Actions control and menu containing Prepare Package only.
  • Collection-local checkbox gutters and Select all/Clear/Done.
  • Reuse or extraction of pure selection transitions without changing main Index behavior.
  • A separate collection-keyed selection owner and lifecycle.
  • Optional sub_scope support across the package browser client, config, documents, context, prepare request, source loader, engine handoff, result, activity, and metadata.
  • Flat-collection effective-selection rules.
  • Explicit export-only projection and returned-review exclusion.
  • Non-viewable, missing-summary, stale-ID, empty-selection, cancel, success, failure, and retry evidence.
  • Public/manage module isolation and narrow/dense UI review.

Not In Scope

  • Returned-package review, Docs Review materialization, or Docs Import from a sub-scope package.
  • Copy, Move, bulk Delete, or any other selection action.
  • Parent/descendant expansion inside a flat sub-scope.
  • Selecting the parent report or documents from another collection.
  • Package profile redesign, new external service adapters, or a new package engine.
  • Tag Registry reads, group-based filtering, deduplication, or synchronization.
  • General report filtering/search or main Index interaction redesign.

Delivery Tracker

[ ] SSI-3.0 — Freeze Selection And Package Boundaries

  • [ ] Trace current Index selection transitions, owner lifecycle, gutter, Actions controls, resolver, lazy workflow, and package service/profile owners.
  • [ ] Record which logic is collection-neutral and which remains Index-specific.
  • [ ] Define exact optional-sub_scope request, response, metadata, activity, and export-only projection contracts.
  • [ ] Add test-owned flat, non-viewable, missing-summary, missing-ID, and cross-collection fixtures.
  • [ ] Capture green top-level Index selection and package baselines.

Review gate: approve the separation between shared pure rules, the two state owners, and the package collection boundary before runtime edits.

[ ] SSI-3.1 — Reuse Selection Rules Without Index Drift

  • [ ] Extract or parameterize only the pure selection transitions needed by both owners.
  • [ ] Keep current Index Actions, checkboxes, range behavior, lifecycle, selected targets, and package behavior unchanged.
  • [ ] Add a sub-scope owner keyed by { scope, sub_scope }.
  • [ ] Prove state cannot cross between Index and sub-scope collections.

Review gate: focused contract tests demonstrate current Index parity and independent sub-scope lifecycle before visible sub-scope controls are added.

[ ] SSI-3.2 — Add Collection Selection UI

  • [ ] Contribute the list Actions control, Prepare Package item, checkbox gutters, and Select all/Clear/Done group.
  • [ ] Keep row navigation and checkbox activation separate and retain Shift-range selection across visible eligible rows.
  • [ ] Reconcile list/detail navigation, Back/Forward, inventory refresh, unmount, and manage/public changes.
  • [ ] Preserve Status/non-viewable icons and exact row IDs.
  • [ ] Review realistic dense and narrow Analysis tags layouts.

Review gate: tactile review accepts the list interaction before package service adoption begins.

[ ] SSI-3.3 — Extend Package Preparation

  • [ ] Extend package reads and requests with optional configured sub_scope.
  • [ ] Resolve source and effective IDs within that exact child collection.
  • [ ] Keep top-level profile and package behavior unchanged.
  • [ ] Record complete collection identity in result, activity, internal metadata, and external provenance where applicable.
  • [ ] Force sub-scope preparation into an honest export-only projection.
  • [ ] Exclude sub-scope package output from returned review/import workflows.
  • [ ] Prove submitted IDs and exported records agree exactly.

Review gate: isolated dry-run/write evidence proves exact package contents, provenance, containment, and non-actionable return status.

[ ] SSI-3.4 — End-To-End Acceptance And Closeout

  • [ ] Run focused selection, controller, package model/client/service/engine, metadata, returned-list exclusion, activity, and public isolation checks.
  • [ ] Run route/browser evidence with synthetic source and an isolated writable projects base.
  • [ ] Manually review ordinary, dense, narrow, cancel, success, unavailable, and retry states without mutating real Analysis documents.
  • [ ] Run the maintained Docs Viewer profile at the integration boundary.
  • [ ] Independently review the final diff and exact output/omission claims.
  • [ ] Transfer only shipped contracts to durable selection, package, report, and Sub-Scope Index owners.

Completion Gate

SSI-3 is complete only when checked IDs from one exact sub-scope produce one auditable export-only package, current Index selection/package behavior remains unchanged, and no return/import or public capability has been implied.
